title: Interfaces WireGuard peer validation/safety parity depth pass (IF-15 subset)
acceptance_criteria: WireGuard peer batch API validates endpoint semantics (address vs host-name exclusivity, port dependency, keepalive range).
WireGuard peer batch API rejects duplicate allowed-ips within a peer and collisions against other peers on the same interface.
Create/Edit WireGuard peer modals enforce the same validation constraints client-side before submit.
Backend regression tests cover the new peer validation logic and pass locally.
Frontend gates pass (tsc, targeted eslint, build, runtime smoke, UI smoke).
assumptions: WireGuard option-depth work remains partial after this slice; this pass focuses on peer safety/validation behavior.
Existing /vyos/vpn/wireguard endpoints remain authoritative and unchanged in contract surface.

tasks.notes: Added peer batch validation helpers for endpoint semantics, allowed-IP validation, and collision checks.
Added matching client-side validation guardrails and passed interface context to EditPeer modal for cross-peer collision checks.
Added endpoint regression coverage for endpoint exclusivity, duplicate allowed-ips, missing endpoint port, keepalive range, and successful valid path.
Close remaining IF-15 loopback edge-depth gaps, then continue next backlog domain.
